job.title: Associate SRE / Site Reliability Engineer
job.description: FinScale India (Mumbai) runs financial transaction settlement platforms. We are seeking an Associate SRE to monitor distributed system health, track SLOs/SLIs, maintain Prometheus & Grafana alerting, participate in incident postmortems, and automate toil using Python or Go.

pool.text: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Principles: understood error budgets, SLIs, SLOs, and postmortems
Prometheus & Grafana: designed PromQL alert rules, recording rules, and multi-cluster dashboards
Python & Bash Scripting: built automated health checkers and Slack notification webhooks
Linux System Internals: analyzed CPU load averages, iowait, memory paging, and TCP connection states
StatusPulse: lightweight uptime monitoring agent written in Python checking HTTP endpoints and reporting to Grafana
B.E. Information Technology, Mumbai University (VESIT), 2022–2026, CGPA 8.6/10
Log Aggregation (ELK / Loki): queried application traces and structured JSON logs using LogCLI / Kibana
Adobe Photoshop: created posters for college cultural week
SRE Intern at FinScale (Mumbai, 4 months): automated alert triage for staging microservice failures
Networking Fundamentals: deep understanding of DNS records, SSL/TLS handshakes, HTTP status codes, and CIDR
UI Design: created wireframes for mobile sports app
Chaos Engineering: ran basic stress testing using k6 and Chaos Mesh on staging environment
